mapper.select: SELECT id, pet_id AS petId, record_date AS recordDate, weight, poop_condition AS poopCondition, urination_count AS urinationCount, vomiting, morning_food_amount AS morningFoodAmount, morning_no_meal AS morningNoMeal, evening_food_amount AS eveningFoodAmount, evening_no_meal AS eveningNoMeal, memo FROM health_records WHERE pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY record_date DESC

SELECT id, pet_id AS petId, record_date AS recordDate, weight, morning_food_amount AS morningFoodAmount, evening_food_amount AS eveningFoodAmount
FROM health_records WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND record_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ORDER BY record_date ASC

SELECT id, pet_id AS petId, record_date AS recordDate, weight, poop_condition AS poopCondition, urination_count AS urinationCount, vomiting, morning_food_amount AS morningFoodAmount, morning_no_meal AS morningNoMeal, evening_food_amount AS eveningFoodAmount, evening_no_meal AS eveningNoMeal, memo
FROM health_records WHERE pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY record_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, pet_id AS petId, record_date AS recordDate, weight, poop_condition AS poopCondition, urination_count AS urinationCount, vomiting, morning_food_amount AS morningFoodAmount, morning_no_meal AS morningNoMeal, evening_food_amount AS eveningFoodAmount, evening_no_meal AS eveningNoMeal, memo FROM health_records WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, pet_id AS petId, record_date AS recordDate, weight, poop_condition AS poopCondition, urination_count AS urinationCount, vomiting, morning_food_amount AS morningFoodAmount, morning_no_meal AS morningNoMeal, evening_food_amount AS eveningFoodAmount, evening_no_meal AS eveningNoMeal, memo FROM health_records WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND record_date = #{recordDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_records ( pet_id, record_date, weight, poop_condition, urination_count, vomiting, morning_food_amount, morning_no_meal, evening_food_amount, evening_no_meal, memo ) VALUES ( #{petId}, #{recordDate}, #{weight}, #{poopCondition}, #{urinationCount}, #{vomiting}, #{morningFoodAmount}, #{morningNoMeal}, #{eveningFoodAmount}, #{eveningNoMeal}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE health_records SET pet_id = #{petId}, record_date = #{recordDate}, weight = #{weight}, poop_condition = #{poopCondition}, urination_count = #{urinationCount}, vomiting = #{vomiting}, morning_food_amount = #{morningFoodAmount}, morning_no_meal = #{morningNoMeal}, evening_food_amount = #{eveningFoodAmount}, evening_no_meal = #{eveningNoMeal}, memo = #{memo} WHERE id = #{id}
